title: First match search
problem: Return the zero-based index of the first occurrence of target in values. Return -1 only if the target is absent.
reference_code:
fun solution(values, target):
    i = 0
    while (i < length(values)):
        if (values[i] == target):
            return i
        end if
        i += 1
    end while
    return -1
end fun
